description.value: Kami Japanese Restaurant is a sushi and Japanese cuisine spot located inside Strawberry Hill Shopping Centre in Surrey. The menu features sashimi, exotic rolls, and party trays crafted with an emphasis on fresh ingredients. Cyclists passing through the Fraser Valley corridor will find it a convenient sit-down or takeout option in a well-serviced suburban shopping centre.
